title: Check the nested iterator heap effect on four original deployments
description: Certify the registered advanced input of Commons Collections #628 and #755 against two ordinary JVM executions per endpoint. Compare every field and array slot in the bound entry heap with the declared queue, child and cache changes, then replace the actual parent helper in two independent JVMs. Qualify the original next and remove receivers and final public observation. Reject a stale cursor and a missing detached-node write on live disposable executions and check missing, wrong-receiver and cross-deployment receipts.
